description: Send and return pair for a stereo channel with a switch that takes the effect in or out of the path, which turns any effect into a stompbox

params.text: Engages or disengages the effect by hand, in the way the mode switch sets
Sets what a press or a gate does: TOGGLE changes between engaged and disengaged each time, PUSH keeps the effect engaged while the gate is high or the button is held

inputs.text: A gate here engages or disengages the effect, in the way the mode switch sets
The left channel of the unprocessed audio
The right channel of the unprocessed audio
The left channel coming back from the effect
The right channel coming back from the effect

outputs.text: The left channel of the audio, through the effect or around it
The right channel of the audio, through the effect or around it
The left channel sent to the effect
The right channel sent to the effect

notes: the effect being switched is patched between the send outputs and the return inputs; the audio enters at the inputs and leaves at the outputs
